title: Understanding Bottlenecks for Efficiently Serving LLM Inference With KV Offloading
authors: William Meng; Benjamin Lee; Hong Wang
venue_full: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: KV cache offloading enables long-context LLM inference by storing caches in CPU DRAM, but PCIe bandwidth limitations create severe bottlenecks. Existing schedulers and hardware co-design assume prefill is compute-bound, an assumption that breaks once cached tokens substantially outnumber new ones, transforming prefill into memory-bound execution and leaving GPU compute resources underutilized.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache offloading 透過將 cache 儲存於 CPU DRAM 來支援長 context LLM 推理，但 PCIe 頻寬限制造成嚴重瓶頸。現有 scheduler 與硬體協同設計假設 prefill 為 compute-bound，當 cached token 數遠大於新 token 時此假設不再成立，prefill 轉為 memory-bound，導致 GPU 計算資源閒置。

key_innovation.en: An analytical framework that derives kappa_crit, the critical cached-to-prefill token ratio at which prefill execution becomes memory-bound, decomposed into a model factor (kappa_M = F_pf / B_kv) and a hardware factor (kappa_HW = BW_PCIe / C_eff). Pairing kappa_crit with the workload-side kappa_ratio = K/T lets architects, model designers and schedulers reason separately about when offloaded prefill crosses into the bandwidth-limited regime.
key_innovation.zh: 提出分析式框架推導 kappa_crit，即 prefill 由 compute-bound 轉為 memory-bound 的臨界 cached-to-prefill token 比例，並分解為 model factor (kappa_M = F_pf / B_kv) 與 hardware factor (kappa_HW = BW_PCIe / C_eff)。配合工作負載側的 kappa_ratio = K/T，可讓硬體架構師、模型設計者與 scheduler 各自獨立分析 offloaded prefill 何時跨入 bandwidth-limited regime。

key_improvements.en: Empirically shows PCIe overhead reaches 86x prefill computation and accounts for 99% of execution time; GPUs consume only 28% of rated TDP under KV-offloaded serving. Median workload kappa_ratio is 100 for ShareGPT, 5000 for NarrativeQA, and 10000 for FinQA, exceeding hardware kappa_crit (1.06-14.3 across modern platforms) by orders of magnitude. NVLink C2C raises kappa_crit by 5.3x; MLA reduces B_kv by 2.7-4.7x.
key_improvements.zh: 實證顯示 PCIe overhead 達 prefill 計算量的 86 倍、佔執行時間 99%；KV offloaded 服務下 GPU 僅消耗額定 TDP 的 28%。ShareGPT 工作負載 kappa_ratio 中位數為 100、NarrativeQA 為 5000、FinQA 為 10000，遠超現代平台 kappa_crit (1.06-14.3) 數個數量級。NVLink C2C 提升 kappa_crit 5.3x；MLA 將 B_kv 縮減 2.7-4.7x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA B200, NVIDIA A100, HBM3, DDR4-3200 DRAM
node_count: 1 node (server with AMD EPYC 7R13 CPU, 2 TB DDR4-3200)
reported_accuracy: Empirical kappa_crit measured at 2 (Llama-3.1-70B) and 1 (Qwen3-235B-A22B) versus peak-bandwidth estimates of 14.3 and 7.8; recalibrated with measured 15 GB/s sustained PCIe bandwidth, predictions become 3.3 and 1.8 (close to empirical).

scope_assumptions.en: Framework approximates F_pf as 2N FLOPs per token, omitting the context scaling term 2 n_layer n_ctx d_attn (negligible for typical contexts but introduces ~10% error at 65K tokens). Focuses on loading KV caches from CPU DRAM; ignores write-back overhead of storing new prefixes. Disables prefix caching during measurement to isolate PCIe transfer; limits output to one token to simulate a prefill-only server. MLA evaluation deferred to future work due to implementation challenges.
scope_assumptions.zh: 框架以 2N FLOPs/token 近似 F_pf，忽略 2 n_layer n_ctx d_attn 的 context scaling 項（典型 context 下可忽略，但 65K tokens 下會引入約 10% 誤差）。聚焦從 CPU DRAM 載入 KV cache，忽略新 prefix 寫回 DRAM 的 overhead；量測時關閉 prefix caching 以隔離 PCIe transfer，並將輸出限制為單一 token 以模擬 prefill-only server。受限於實作問題，MLA 評估留待後續工作。
